before.requirement: Recognize a type 7 HTML block start whose tag attribute contains a valid non-ASCII UTF-8 value.
before.reason: The before scanner accepts the quoted UTF-8 value and returns 7 for the completed tag line; the block parser opens an HTML block.

after.requirement: Recognize a type 7 HTML block start whose tag attribute contains a valid non-ASCII UTF-8 value.
after.reason: The after scanner accepts the quoted value and returns 7 for the completed tag line; the block parser opens an HTML block.

claims.reason: The same old harness can feed the valid tag to document parsing on both versions, so the frozen recognition behavior remains reachable. Coverage is incomplete because the focus restriction does not assess the other selected change groups.
